 izna — K-Pop Group izna Captivates Taipei and Manila on Tour
 Oct 21, 2026 4:10 PM PDT 
 [Photo] OSEN DB. 
 Group izna has successfully completed their concert tour stops, receiving glowing reviews from local media outlets as a ‘K-pop all-rounder group.’
 izna (Mai, Bang Ji-min, Koko, Yu Sarang, Choi Jung-eun, Jeong Se-bi) recently wrapped up their ‘2026-2027 izna Concert Tour: WHO DAT GIRL?’ in Taipei and Manila to enthusiastic responses.
 Local media outlets extensively spotlighted izna’s impressive performances. Media outlets such as China Times, SETN, yamNews, and Enews highlighted that izna demonstrated overwhelming talent with a five-song full-band opening set, noting that their synchronized choreography delivered both high musical completion and striking visuals.
 Liberty Times, Yahoo News, Line Today, and Tai Sounds focused heavily on the unit stages. Mai, Yu Sarang, and Jeong Se-bi performed Girls’ Generation’s ‘Kissing You,’ while Bang Ji-min, Koko, and Choi Jung-eun showcased aespa’s ‘Illusion,’ creating an intriguing contrast between lovely and chic concepts.
 Additionally, Mirror Daily News and mnews emphasized that member Choi Jung-eun made a surprise appearance from the audience to kick off the opening performance. Youth Daily News praised izna as a ‘K-POP all-rounder group,’ highlighting the members’ exceptional musical capabilities.
 ABS-CBN News noted that ‘the diverse music and infectious energy made two hours fly by,’ while Manila Bulletin added that ‘from harmony-filled choreography to special cover performances, they delivered unique excitement and fueled fans’ enthusiasm.’
 Through their debut concert tour ‘WHO DAT GIRL?’, starting in Seoul and moving through Taipei and Manila, izna continues to solidify their growing global presence.
 Communicating closely with fans in local languages, showcasing trending challenges, and singing popular OST snippets, izna is building massive anticipation for the remainder of their tour.
